tools.name: get_delayed_score
tools.description: The BTC Intel Score (0 to 100) for a day up to the Delayed date, three months behind the live record, as the public site shows it. Without a date: the latest delayed day. A date after the Delayed date is refused.

tools.name: get_market_read
tools.description: The public market read: for the Full Read and each Analysis page (technical, on-chain, market structure, sentiment, macro, cross-market, liquidity, cycle), its state word and its summary line, as printed on the site.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: The latest public Brief (the daily read) and the latest public Weekly Brief: their headlines, dates and links.

tools.name: get_plan_rules
tools.description: The public Intel DCA ladder, word for word from btcintel.org/intel-dca/: what each plan (Defensive, Balanced, Growth) does on payday at each Score level, and the notes under the ladder.

tools.name: get_live_score
tools.description: The live BTC Intel Score (0 to 100), its level and its date. $0.25 a call in bitcoin over Lightning, one call per payment. Call it without "payment" to get a Lightning invoice and a macaroon; pay the invoice with a Lightning wallet; call it again with payment = "<macaroon>:<preimage>".
